verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents image inputs to vision-capable models through the standard OpenAI `image_url` content shape, so one multimodal mode beyond text chat is available on the same API. The evidence shows nothing for audio or image generation, and the vision support rests on two short doc snippets. Missing for 10: audio model support, image-generation models, a list of which models are vision-capable, independent or hands-on corroboration of vision use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call vision, audio, or image-generation models beyond text chat on the same platform

citations.quote: The standard OpenAI `image_url` content shape is supported. Supply the image as a base64 data URI
